{{Quote|It has come to the Empire's attention that dissident elements engaging in a tawdry and potentially dangerous seasonal event are planning to infect Imperial space with their insipid notions.|Extract from the edict|<ref name="Holonet" />}}
'''Imperial Edict GR-1NC4''' was a law created by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]],<ref name="Holonet" /> in [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> That edict was issued following of the [[Life Day Revelers]] on [[Vaiken Spacedock]]. It ordered all Imperial personnel not to engage in any of the seasonal, cheerful activities proposed by the Revelers, which were considered unbecoming of the Empire, as well as placed a ban on and warning about various items representing the holiday, including [[Sleigh I]] (due to its jingle bells being suspected to indicate the parcels contain [[Bomb/Legends|explosives]]), [[Life Day Holo-Tree]]s, and [[Gree technology|Cyan Spheres]] (the last of which had most of its description being heavily redacted).<ref name="Holonet" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The code for the edict, GR-1NC4, is reference to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grinch Grinch], a character who also loathes the holiday of Christmas, which Life Day is inspired from.
